drivers: Chiral Z-pentomino requires mirror-vs-rotation discrimination, a classic mental-rotation demand
Three of four options shown at diagonal (45°-step) angles, which are harder to mentally align than orthogonal ones
Option A at 180° is identical to the upright target (Z shape is 180°-symmetric), giving one easy pick
Must select both correct options within 30 s; no partial credit, so one error on a diagonal option fails the item
